a registered user with role `\"player\"`.\n    Player,\n}\n\n/// Extract a `Bearer` token from the `Authorization` header, if present.\nfn extract_auth_token(req: &str) -> Option<&str> {\n    for line in req.lines() {\n        let lower = line.to_lowercase();\n        if lower.starts_with(\"authorization:\") {\n            let val = line.splitn(2, ':').nth(1)?.trim();\n            if val.to_lowercase().starts_with(\"bearer \") {\n                return Some(val[6..].trim());\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    None\n}\n\n/// Require a valid bearer token with the given role.\n///\n/// Returns the authenticated username on success. Missing or malformed\n/// credentials return `Unauthorized`; a role mismatch returns `Forbidden`.\nfn require_auth(\n    req: &str,\n    users: &HashMap<String, User>,\n    requirement: AuthRequirement,\n) -> Result<String, auth::AuthError> {\n    let token = extract_auth_token(req).ok_or(auth::AuthError::Unauthorized)?;\n    let (username, role) = auth::verify_bearer(token, users)?;\n    match requirement {\n        AuthRequirement::Any => Ok(username),\n        AuthRequirement::Dm if role == \"dm\" => Ok(username),\n        AuthRequirement::Player if role == \"player\" => Ok(username),\n        _ => Err(auth::AuthError::Forbidden),\n    }\n}\n\n/// Parse one HTTP request, route it, and write the response.\n///\n/// Both in-memory state maps are locked for the duration of the request so that\n/// reads and writes are serialized and persistence is consistent.\nfn dispatch_request(stream: &mut TcpStream) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n    let req = read_request(stream)?;\n    let first = req.lines().next().unwrap_or(\"\");\n    let parts: Vec<&str> = first.split_whitespace().collect();\n    if parts.len() < 2 {\n        return respond(stream, 400, BAD_REQUEST);\n    }\n    let method = parts[0];\n    let path = parts[1];\n    let body = extract_body(&req);\n\n    let mut sessions = SESSIONS.lock().unwrap();\n    let mut users = USERS.lock().unwrap();\n\n    let (status, response) = match method {\n        \"GET\" => dispatch_get(path, &req, &sessions, &users),\n        \"POST\" => dispatch_post(path, body, &req, &mut sessions, &mut users),\n        \"PUT\" => dispatch_put(path, body, &req, &mut sessions, &mut users),\n        \"DELETE\" => dispatch_delete(path, body, &req, &mut sessions, &mut users),\n        _ => (404, NOT_FOUND.to_string()),\n    };\n    respond(stream, status, &response)\n}\n\n/// Return the body portion of a fully read HTTP request.\nfn extract_body(req: &str) -> &str {\n    if let the destination.\npub fn travel_turn(\n    campaign_id: &str,\n    body: &str,\n    actor: &str,\n) -> Result<String, PlayError> {\n    if !play_campaign_exists(campaign_id).map_err(|_| play_narration_create(campaign_id, sequence, \"travel\", actor, &destination_id)\n        .map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    play_campaign_update_turn(campaign_id, \"dm\", \"dm\", turn_number)\n        .map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    play_campaign_set_current_location(campaign_id, &destination_id)\n        .map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n\n    Ok(format!(\n This migration runs\n/// unconditionally on startup and adds any missing columns with safe defaults.\nfn migrate_play_campaign_members() -> Result<(), String> {\n    let sql = \"PRAGMA table_info(play_campaign_members);\";\n    let output = sqlite_query(sql)?;\n    let content = extract_top_array_content(&output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n    let mut has_status = false;\n    let mut Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Drop all application tables and recreate a fresh schema.\n///\n/// This is a destructive operation used by the storage reset endpoint.\npub fn reset_db() -> Result<(), String> {\n    let sql = r#\"\n        PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS schema_meta;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS combat_sessions;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS combatants;\n        DROP fails, the database is\n/// reported as uninitialized with version 0.\npub fn storage_status() -> Result<(i64, bool), String> {\n    let sql = \"SELECT version, initialized FROM schema_meta WHERE version = 1;\";\n    match sqlite_query(sql) {\n        Ok(output) => {\n            let content = extract_top_array_content(&output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n            let objects = extract_objects(content);\n            if objects.is_empty() {\n                return Ok((0, false));\n            }\n            let obj = objects[0];\n            let version = extract_int(obj, \"version\").unwrap_or(0);\n            let initialized = extract_int(obj, \"initialized\").unwrap_or(0) != 0;\n            Ok((version, initialized))\n        }\n        Err(_) => Ok((0, false)),\n    }\n}\n\n/// Load persistent users and combat sessions from SQLite into the in-memory\n/// caches.\n///\n/// This is called once at startup. Existing in-memory contents are cleared and\n/// replaced by the persisted state.\npub fn load_storage(\n    sessions: &mut std::collections::HashMap<String, CombatSession>,\n    users: &mut std::collections::HashMap<String, User>,\n) -> Result<(), String> {\n    users.clear();\n    sessions.clear();\n\n    let users_output = sqlite_query(\"SELECT username, role, password_hash FROM users;\")?;\n    let users_content = extract_top_array_content(&users_output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n    for obj in extract_objects(users_content) {\n        let username = extract_string(obj, \"username\")\n            .ok_or(\"missing username\")?\n            .to_string();\n        let role = extract_string(obj, \"role\").ok_or(\"missing role\")?.to_string();\n        let password_hash = extract_string(obj, \"password_hash\")\n            .ok_or(\"missing password_hash\")?\n            .to_string();\n        users.insert(\n            username.clone(),\n            User {\n                username,\n                role,\n                password_hash,\n            },\n        );\n    }\n\n    let sessions_output = sqlite_query(\"SELECT id, round, turn_index FROM combat_sessions;\")?;\n    let sessions_content = extract_top_array_content(&sessions_output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n    for obj in extract_objects(sessions_content) {\n        let id = extract_string(obj, \"id\").ok_or(\"missing id\")?.to_string();\n        let round = extract_int(obj, \"round\").ok_or(\"missing round\")?;\n        let turn_index = extract_int(obj, \"turn_index\").ok_or(\"missing turn_index\")? as usize;\n\n        let c_sql = format!(\n            \"SELECT name, score, dex, position FROM combatants WHERE session_id = '{}' ORDER BY position;\",\n            sql_escape(&id)\n        );\n        let c_output = sqlite_query(&c_sql)?;\n        let c_content = extract_top_array_content(&c_output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n        let mut order = Vec::new();\n        for c_obj in extract_objects(c_content) {\n            let name = extract_string(c_obj, \"name\")\n                .ok_or(\"missing combatant name\")?\n                .to_string();\n            let score = extract_int(c_obj, \"score\").ok_or(\"missing score\")?;\n            let dex = extract_int(c_obj, \"dex\").ok_or(\"missing dex\")?;\n            order.push(crate::domain::Combatant { name, score, dex });\n        }\n\n        let cond_sql = format!(\n            \"SELECT target, condition, remaining FROM conditions WHERE session_id = '{}';\",\n            sql_escape(&id)\n        );\n        let cond_output = sqlite_query(&cond_sql)?;\n        let cond_content = extract_top_array_content(&cond_output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n        let mut conditions = std::collections::HashMap::new();\n        for cond_obj in extract_objects(cond_content) {\n            let target = extract_string(cond_obj, \"target\")\n                .ok_or(\"missing target\")?\n                .to_string();\n            let name = extract_string(cond_obj, \"condition\")\n                .ok_or(\"missing condition\")?\n                .to_string();\n            let remaining = extract_int(cond_obj, \"remaining\").ok_or(\"missing remaining\")?;\n            conditions\n                .entry(target)\n                .or_insert_with(Vec::new)\n                .push(crate::domain::Condition { name, remaining });\n        }\n\n        sessions.insert(\n            id.clone(),\n            CombatSession {\n                id,\n                round,\n                turn_index,\n                order,\n                conditions,\n            },\n        );\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Persist the entire in-memory state to SQLite.\n///\n/// This function is intentionally simple: it deletes all rows from the mutable\n/// tables and re-inserts them from the in-memory caches. The busy timeout\n/// helps prevent conflicts with rapid sequential requests.\npub fn save_storage(\n    sessions: &std::collections::HashMap<String, CombatSession>,\n    users: &std::collections::HashMap<String, User>,\n) -> Result<(), String> {\n    let mut sql = String::from(\n        \"PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000;\\nDELETE FROM conditions;\\nDELETE FROM combatants;\\nDELETE FROM combat_sessions;\\nDELETE FROM users;\\n\",\n    );\n\n    for user in users.values() {\n        sql.push_str(&format!(\n            \"INSERT INTO users (username, role, password_hash) VALUES ('{}', '{}', '{}');\\n\",\n            sql_escape(&user.username),\n            sql_escape(&user.role),\n            sql_escape(&user.password_hash)\n        ));\n    }\n\n    for session in sessions.values() {\n        sql.push_str(&format!(\n            \"INSERT INTO combat_sessions (id, round, turn_index) VALUES ('{}', {}, {});\\n\",\n            sql_escape(&session.id),\n            session.round,\n            session.turn_index\n        ));\n        for (position, c) in session.order.iter().enumerate() {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\n                \"INSERT INTO combatants (session_id, name, score, dex, position) VALUES ('{}', '{}', {}, {}, {});\\n\",\n                sql_escape(&session.id),\n                sql_escape(&c.name),\n                c.score,\n                c.dex,\n                position\n            ));\n        }\n        for (target, list) in &session.conditions {\n            for c in list {\n                sql.push_str(&format!(\n                    \"INSERT INTO conditions (session_id, target, condition, remaining) VALUES ('{}', '{}', '{}', {});\\n\",\n                    sql_escape(&session.id),\n                    sql_escape(target),\n                    sql_escape(&c.name),\n                    c.remaining\n                ));\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    sqlite_exec(&sql)\n}\n\n/// Check whether a compendium slug already exists in the given table.\npub fn compendium_slug_exists(table: &str, slug: &str) -> Result<bool, String> {\n    let sql = migrate_play_encounters_rewards()?;\n    migrate_play_campaigns_exploration_actor()?;\n    migrate_play_campaign_members_build()\n}\n\n/// Add missing death-save columns to an existing This migration runs\n/// unconditionally on startup and adds any missing columns with safe defaults.\nfn migrate_play_campaign_members() -> Result<(), String> {\n    let sql = \"PRAGMA table_info(play_campaign_members);\";\n    let output = sqlite_query(sql)?;\n    let content = extract_top_array_content(&output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n    let mut has_status = false;\n    let mut Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Drop all application tables and recreate a fresh schema.\n///\n/// This is a destructive operation used by the storage reset endpoint.\npub fn reset_db() -> Result<(), String> {\n    let sql = r#\"\n        PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS schema_meta;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS combat_sessions;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS combatants;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS conditions;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS monsters;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS monster_tags;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS items;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS events;\n        DROP EXISTS play_locations;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_location_connections;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_encounters;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_encounter_monsters;\n        DROP fails, the database is\n/// reported as uninitialized with version 0.\npub fn storage_status() -> Result<(i64, bool), String> {\n    let sql = \"SELECT version, initialized FROM schema_meta WHERE version = 1;\";\n    match sqlite_query(sql) {\n        Ok(output) => {\n            let content = extract_top_array_content(&output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n            let objects = extract_objects(content);\n            if objects.is_empty() {\n                return Ok((0, false));\n            }\n            let obj = objects[0];\n            let version = extract_int(obj, \"version\").unwrap_or(0);\n            let initialized = extract_int(obj, \"initialized\").unwrap_or(0) != 0;\n            Ok((version, initialized))\n        }\n        Err(_) => Ok((0, false)),\n    }\n}\n\n/// Load persistent users and combat sessions from SQLite into the in-memory\n/// caches.\n///\n/// This is called once at startup. Existing in-memory contents are cleared and\n/// replaced by the persisted state.\npub fn load_storage(\n    sessions: &mut std::collections::HashMap<String, CombatSession>,\n    users: &mut std::collections::HashMap<String, User>,\n) -> Result<(), String> {\n    users.clear();\n    sessions.clear();\n\n    let users_output = sqlite_query(\"SELECT username, role, password_hash FROM users;\")?;\n    let users_content = extract_top_array_content(&users_output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n    for obj in extract_objects(users_content) {\n        let username = extract_string(obj, \"username\")\n            .ok_or(\"missing username\")?\n            .to_string();\n        let role = extract_string(obj, \"role\").ok_or(\"missing role\")?.to_string();\n        let password_hash = extract_string(obj, \"password_hash\")\n            .ok_or(\"missing password_hash\")?\n            .to_string();\n        users.insert(\n            username.clone(),\n            User {\n                username,\n                role,\n                password_hash,\n            },\n        );\n    }\n\n    let sessions_output = sqlite_query(\"SELECT id, round, turn_index FROM combat_sessions;\")?;\n    let sessions_content = extract_top_array_content(&sessions_output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n    for obj in extract_objects(sessions_content) {\n        let id = extract_string(obj, \"id\").ok_or(\"missing id\")?.to_string();\n        let round = extract_int(obj, \"round\").ok_or(\"missing round\")?;\n        let turn_index = extract_int(obj, \"turn_index\").ok_or(\"missing turn_index\")? as usize;\n\n        let c_sql = format!(\n            \"SELECT name, score, dex, position FROM combatants WHERE session_id = '{}' ORDER BY position;\",\n            sql_escape(&id)\n        );\n        let c_output = sqlite_query(&c_sql)?;\n        let c_content = extract_top_array_content(&c_output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n        let mut order = Vec::new();\n        for c_obj in extract_objects(c_content) {\n            let name = extract_string(c_obj, \"name\")\n                .ok_or(\"missing combatant name\")?\n                .to_string();\n            let score = extract_int(c_obj, \"score\").ok_or(\"missing score\")?;\n            let dex = extract_int(c_obj, \"dex\").ok_or(\"missing dex\")?;\n            order.push(crate::domain::Combatant { name, score, dex });\n        }\n\n        let cond_sql = format!(\n            \"SELECT target, condition, remaining FROM conditions WHERE session_id = '{}';\",\n            sql_escape(&id)\n        );\n        let cond_output = sqlite_query(&cond_sql)?;\n        let cond_content = extract_top_array_content(&cond_output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n        let mut conditions = std::collections::HashMap::new();\n        for cond_obj in extract_objects(cond_content) {\n            let target = extract_string(cond_obj, \"target\")\n                .ok_or(\"missing target\")?\n                .to_string();\n            let name = extract_string(cond_obj, \"condition\")\n                .ok_or(\"missing condition\")?\n                .to_string();\n            let remaining = extract_int(cond_obj, \"remaining\").ok_or(\"missing remaining\")?;\n            conditions\n                .entry(target)\n                .or_insert_with(Vec::new)\n                .push(crate::domain::Condition { name, remaining });\n        }\n\n        sessions.insert(\n            id.clone(),\n            CombatSession {\n                id,\n                round,\n                turn_index,\n                order,\n                conditions,\n            },\n        );\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Persist the entire in-memory state to SQLite.\n///\n/// This function is intentionally simple: it deletes all rows from the mutable\n/// tables and re-inserts them from the in-memory caches. The busy timeout\n/// helps prevent conflicts with rapid sequential requests.\npub fn save_storage(\n    sessions: &std::collections::HashMap<String, CombatSession>,\n    users: &std::collections::HashMap<String, User>,\n) -> Result<(), String> {\n    let mut sql = String::from(\n        \"PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000;\\nDELETE FROM conditions;\\nDELETE FROM combatants;\\nDELETE FROM combat_sessions;\\nDELETE FROM users;\\n\",\n    );\n\n    for user in users.values() {\n        sql.push_str(&format!(\n            \"INSERT INTO users (username, role, password_hash) VALUES ('{}', '{}', '{}');\\n\",\n            sql_escape(&user.username),\n            sql_escape(&user.role),\n            sql_escape(&user.password_hash)\n        ));\n    }\n\n    for session in sessions.values() {\n        sql.push_str(&format!(\n            \"INSERT INTO combat_sessions (id, round, turn_index) VALUES ('{}', {}, {});\\n\",\n            sql_escape(&session.id),\n            session.round,\n            session.turn_index\n        ));\n        for (position, c) in session.order.iter().enumerate() {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\n                \"INSERT INTO combatants (session_id, name, score, dex, position) VALUES ('{}', '{}', {}, {}, {});\\n\",\n                sql_escape(&session.id),\n                sql_escape(&c.name),\n                c.score,\n                c.dex,\n                position\n            ));\n        }\n        for (target, list) in &session.conditions {\n            for c in list {\n                sql.push_str(&format!(\n                    \"INSERT INTO conditions (session_id, target, condition, remaining) VALUES ('{}', '{}', '{}', {});\\n\",\n                    sql_escape(&session.id),\n                    sql_escape(target),\n                    sql_escape(&c.name),\n                    c.remaining\n                ));\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    sqlite_exec(&sql)\n}\n\n/// Check whether a compendium slug already exists in the given table.\npub fn compendium_slug_exists(table: &str, slug: &str) -> Result<bool, String> {\n    let sql = {\n        return Err(PlayError::NotFound);\n    }\n    let (member_actor, _char_id, hp_current, _hp_max, successes, failures, status) =\n        play_campaign_member_by_character_id(campaign_id, character_id)\n            .map_err(|_| PlayError::NotFound)?;\n    if member_actor != actor {\n        return Err(PlayError::Forbidden);\n    }\n    if status != \"unconscious\" || hp_current != 0 || successes >= 3 || failures >= 3 {\n        return Err(PlayError::Conflict);\n    }\n    let outcome = extract_string(body, \"outcome\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if outcome != \"success\" && outcome != \"failure\" {\n        return Err(PlayError::BadRequest);\n    }\n    let (new_successes, new_failures, new_status) = if outcome == \"success\" {\n        let s = successes + 1;\n        if s >= 3 {\n            (s, failures, \"stable\")\n        } else {\n            (s, failures, \"unconscious\")\n        }\n    } else {\n        let f = failures + 1;\n        if f >= 3 {\n            (successes, f, \"dead\")\n        } else {\n            (successes, f, \"unconscious\")\n        }\n    };\n    play_campaign_member_set_death_saves_status(\n        campaign_id,\n        &member_actor,\n        new_successes,\n        new_failures,\n        new_status,\n    )\n    .map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    Ok(format!(\n        r#\"{{\"character_id\":\"{}\",\"successes\":{},\"failures\":{},\"status\":\"{}\"}}\"#,\n        escape_json(character_id),\n        new_successes,\n        new_failures,\n        escape_json(new_status)\n    ))\n}\n\n/// Read a campaign character's current health status.\n///\n/// GET /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/characters/{char_id}/status\n///\n/// The campaign owner or any member may read the status.\npub fn get_character_status(\n    campaign_id: &str,\n    character_id: &str,\n    actor: &str,\n) -> Result<String, PlayError> {\n    if !play_campaign_exists(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)? extract_string(body, \"class\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let background = extract_string(body, \"background\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let abilities = \"dex\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let con = extract_int(abilities, \"con\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let int = extract_int(abilities, \"int\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let wis = extract_int(abilities, \"wis\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let cha = extract_int(abilities, \"cha\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n\n    if !valid_race(&race) || !valid_class(&class) || !valid_background(&background) {\n        return Err(PlayError::BadRequest);\n    }\n    if str < 1 || str > 30\n        || dex < 1 || dex > 30\n        || con < 1 || con > 30\n        || int < 1 || int > 30\n        || wis < 1 || wis > 30\n        || cha < 1 || cha > 30\n    {\n        return Err(PlayError::BadRequest);\n    }\n\n    let level = 1;\n    let con_modifier   }\n}\n\n/// Parse a play encounter conditions collection path.\n///\n/// `/v1/play/campaigns/{id}/encounters/{enc_id}/conditions` returns\n/// `(campaign_id, encounter_id)`.\npub fn     .collect::<Vec<_>>()\n        .join(\",\");\n    Ok(format!(\"{{{}}}\", entries))\n}\n\n/// Apply a named condition to an encounter combatant.\n///\n/// POST
